blocks.text: This chapter discusses simple harmonic motion (S.H.M.), a special type of oscillatory motion in which a restoring force always pulls the object back towards its mean position. It explores the mathematics and physics behind S.H.M.: its characteristics, its equations and its real-world applications.

blocks.title: Interesting information
blocks.text: Many natural phenomena show periodic motion: the motion of the Earth around the Sun, the Moon around the Earth, water waves, sound waves, a tuning fork, a rocking chair and many others.

blocks.prompt: Name three examples of periodic motion in nature.
blocks.explanation: Any three of: the Earth around the Sun, the Moon around the Earth, water waves, sound waves, a vibrating tuning fork.

items: S.H.M.: oscillation in which a restoring force pulls the body back to its mean position.
